full_judgment: 3. The petitioner as sole-defendant resisted the suit on presentation of a written statement traversing all the material allegations made in the plaint. Averments made were that Banuram Muchi took pattan (settlement) of suit property about 50 years back together with some other properties from landlords. Banuram Muchi having exercised his ownership and possession over the suit property transferred the same along with other properties to Alhaj Abdul Khaleque Munshi the predecessor father of defendant by a sale deed dated 2.8.1952 and inducted transferee Abdul Khaleque Munshi into possession thereon. Abdul Khaleque Munshi built two buts, planted trees, exercised acts of possession on the properties, opened Two Municipal Holdings being Nos. 126 and 127 in his name got suit property recorded in his name in State Acquisition Record of Right, paid rents and got Rent. Receipts and also paid Municipal Taxes and got Municipal Tax Receipts. Abdul Khaleque Munshi endowed the suit property as Waqf by a deed of Waqf dated 14.5.1955 got the same enrolled as Waqf Estate No. 1941 and became the First Mutwalli. On the death of Abdul Khaleque Munshi, Al-haj Abdul Majid, the husband of defendant became Mutwalli as per condition contained in the deed of waqf and also the order of the Administrator of Waqf contained in Memo dated 20.10.1985. Defendant used to possess suit property through various monthly tenants including the plaintiff as one of them. Plaintiff defaulted in payment of rent and a case being Case No. 384 of 1983 was presented before the Martial Law Authority. Martial Law Authority on hearing both the parties directed the police to evict plaintiff who stood evicted from suit property on 10.7.1983. Getting possession back, defendant used to possess suit property through one Askar Ali who used to possess with his family members. Askar Ali was subsequently' ousted by Plaintiff on 12.3.1984 diming the pendency of suit. Positive stand taken by the defendant was that Plaintiff's agreement for sale was forged and created and the deeds of conveyance in favour of Plaintiff were all created documents through false presentation in collusion with witnesses to the deeds. Further stand taken was that Cadestral Survey Khatian stood in the name of imaginary persons who never possessed and Neoti, Nasimon, Rabeya and Jahuruddin are fictitious persons and not the heirs of Cadestral Survey recorded tenants. Further statement was that the cause of action disclosed in the plaint was absolutely false and the suit also stood barred by limitation.
